body:
## Summary

Plans without quantum-noise sites still walk every active lane during packed noise sampling. Finalize presampled symbols and return immediately for these plans, preserving RNG state and avoiding activation setup and the empty per-lane loop. Remove the now-unreachable empty-hazard conditional.

This is a candidate optimization pending reference-host validation. The broader RC benchmark investigation is tracked separately in #656.

## Performance validation

Matched native C++ builds on an AMD EPYC 9554P VM used GCC 13 Release, an x86-64-v2 baseline, runtime AVX-512 and one pinned CPU:

| Workload | Unmodified parent | This change | Result |
| --- | ---: | ---: | --- |
| Draper, batch 1,024, 2,048 shots/call | 8.503 us/call | 6.8705 us/call | 19.2% lower latency |
| Cultivation d3 control, batch 256 | 2.361m shots/s | 2.395m shots/s | +1.44% throughput |
| Cultivation d3 control, batch 2,048 | 2.647m shots/s | 2.616m shots/s | -1.18% throughput |

Draper used four fresh processes per build in ABBA then BAAB order, with 400,000 calls per process. Output checksums and worker storage match. The d3 batch-2,048 loss repeated across both blocks; batch 256 used one ABBA block. These are local native timings, not reference-host Python/wheel results. Code placement affects this workload, so keep the PR in draft until matched EC2 builds confirm the benefit and assess the noisy-control cost.

Remaining performance validation: compare parent `69b5869267c1823ded4bc7156c76d9673c350ba5` with patch `6abe2509d57acedbae2b2b497e28379f106194f4` using identical wheel build settings. Measure Draper at batch 1,024 and d3 at batches 256 and 2,048, using fresh A/B/B/A workers and five 30-second samples each. The shared host settings and measurement procedure are in #656.

## Test plan

- [x] All 1,245 CTest cases pass in an optimized GCC 13 build with `CLIFFT_FORCE_ASSERTS=ON`. Existing tests cover noiseless and noisy RNG behavior, external inputs, readout and packed execution.
- [x] Pre-commit checks pass (`uv run --frozen --only-group dev pre-commit run --all-files --show-diff-on-failure`).
- [x] `git diff --check` passes.
- [x] Matched local native measurements and Draper output checksums checked.
- [ ] Matched reference-host performance checks described above.

Python integration tests and documentation examples were not rerun for this C++-only change.

title: perf: skip packed noise sampling for plans without noise sites
